consoleText:
This program selects two random numbers a and b, in the
range 100-999, and then outputs various mathematical
functions of the fraction a/b. The results are expressed
to 4 decimal places, and a denominator of 1000000 is
used in the calculations to provide precision, even
though the Turtle functions strictly operate only on
integers and produce integer results.

a = 100; b = 738
a/b = 100/738 = 0.1355

square(100/738) = 0.0184
square root(100/738) = 0.3681
cube(100/738) = 0.0025
cube root(100/738) = 0.5136

hypot(100,738) = 744.7443
calculated hypot(100,738) = 744.7443

sin(100/738°) = 0.0024
cos(100/738°) = 1.0000
tan(100/738°) = 0.0024

ln(100/738) = -1.9988
exp(100/738) = 1.1451
log10(100/738) = -0.8681
antilog(100/738) = 1.3662

arccos(100/738) = 82.2124°
arcsin(100/738) = 7.7876°
arctan(100/738) = 7.7167°
